g.text: 2023 El Niño: Seasonal RO and Standard PMM

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #9b4335

g.text: February–June monthly-state initializations; monthly leads 1–9 (45 pairs). Lead 0 is shown but not scored.
PMM = official canonical MCA SST index. Every state, including PMM, evolves freely after initialization.
Ocean state: GODAS area-mean D20 (m), a WWV proxy; it is not the Maryland 0–300 m heat-content budget.
Shared 2015/2023 scales: σT = 0.852 °C; σh = 5.536 m. Detrended manuscript coordinates.
Monthly-state initialization uses a completed month; this is not a historical real-time issue-date experiment.
